description: Ministry of Defence - The Lists of Air Force Personnel approved for the Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel (both officers and airmen) for completing 12 years of service. This falls under public sector service recognition and benefits, specifically within the armed forces, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel appointment (which would be Type 2 or 3).
